reviews.author: Jaicia Mills
reviews.text: If we could give more stars we would. We stayed in the Wagon just for an evening and did horse back riding to celebrate our anniversary. The property is gorgeous, and staff were all so super nice. A storm did come throughout the night, however the wagon was so comfortable that it wasn’t awful/uncomfortable. We definitely plan on going back in the future!

reviews.author: Daniel Jaques
reviews.text:
Our stay at the ranch was nothing short of amazing. We got to go on a peaceful, beautiful horseback ride, the whole experience was incredibly calming.

Dinner was fantastic-perfectly cooked steak with vegetables and a potato, followed by little cheesecake bites that were the perfect dessert. They even made a fire for us afterward, which made the evening feel warm and cozy.

We spent the night in one of their wagon rooms, and it was wonderfully comfortable, unique, and relaxing. They also worked really well with our schedule for booking everything, which made everything even easier and more enjoyable.

Every single person we interacted with was welcoming, friendly, and extremely attentive. You can truly tell they care about making your experience special.

Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for a peaceful getaway with great people, great food, and unforgettable experiences.

reviews.author: Shannon Scalisi
reviews.text: I can't say enough amazing things about this ranch!! From the beginning to the end hands down the best horseback riding I've experienced. It was my boyfriends 1st time on a horse and they were so good at getting him familiar with the horse and riding. The young gal Sophia was our guide and she did such an amazing job and took great pics!! The place was STUNNING!! The horses were so gentle so if you are hesitant, DON'T be! My girl Eden was such such a good girl!! I wish there were 10 stars because this place and their people deserve more than 5!! Can't wait to go back!!!

reviews.author: Miguel AJ_Graphics
reviews.text: Incredible Experience! The staff was so friendly and helped outs in anyway possible. Definitely going back to ride again and maybe even stay a night. Book them if you ever want to ride for the first time or have ridden. It will be great experience for anyone. Thanks Logan and all the other helpers. Did a wonderful Job and made a memorable experience. They also take photos of you riding the horses as well so you don't have to worry about your shaky phone when riding. Have Fun!

reviews.author: Cody Brown
reviews.text: This place is awesome. We signed up for a trail ride for my wife's birthday and brought along our little 3 year old. The staff was super nice and also informative enough that you felt safe around the animals. They were great about making sure you got all the pictures you could want as well. The horses were beautiful and so was the scenery. I will definitely be doing this again.
